sources.snippet: The Pythia Scaling Suite is a collection of models developed to facilitate interpretability research (see paper). It contains two sets of eight models of sizes 70M, 160M, 410M, 1B, 1.4B, 2.8B, 6.9B, and 12B. sources.title: Pythia-410M: Open-Source Language Model for LLM Research
sources.snippet: pythia-410m Pythia-410M is a 410-million-parameter open-source language model developed by EleutherAI for interpretability research. It is a causal language model trained on the Pile dataset (825 GiB of diverse English text).
